# Alicia Ortego

> Children's author Alicia Ortego creates mindful picture books that teach social-emotional learning and core values to young readers through her engaging Superpower series.

Alicia Ortego's website showcases a collection of SEL-focused children's books designed for ages 3-8, emphasizing emotional intelligence and character development. The site offers individual book sales, wholesale options for schools and organizations, and educational resources including blog content on parenting and child development.

## Key Topics

- Social-Emotional Learning (SEL)
- Children's Picture Books
- Superpower Series
- Values Education
- Emotional Intelligence
- Mindfulness for Children
- Ages 4-8 Target Audience
- Wholesale & Bulk Pricing
- Character Development
- Kindness & Empathy
- Breathing Techniques
- Self-Esteem & Confidence
- Gratitude & Acceptance
- Integrity & Honesty
- Book Series Collections
